title: My First English Class · 写作迁移
instructions: 下课后给英语老师写2—8个简单句、至少12词。用I am说明自己的身份和感受，用You are对老师说一句符合情境的话；可自编信息。独立写原稿，不把整段示例换一个姓名当作新作品。
prompt: Write 2–8 simple sentences to your English teacher after class. Use I am to say who you are and how you feel. Use You are to say something about the teacher you are addressing. Use your own or invented details and write at least 12 words. Do not copy a complete example.
